periocular_spatial_geometry.dominant_axis_orientation: Primary axis is oriented diagonally, approximately 40-50 degrees relative to the vertical midline, sloping downwards and outwards.
periocular_spatial_geometry.aspect_ratio_factor: Elongated ovals with a high aspect ratio, where the vertical length is approximately 1.8 times the horizontal width.
periocular_spatial_geometry.inferior_centroid_shift: Pronounced downward tapering creating a teardrop effect, with the majority of the black pigment mass situated below the horizontal center of the eye.

cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.inter_bounding_box_euclidean_distance: The gap between the medial edges of the black pinna regions is approximately 1.5 times the width of a single ear base.
cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.apex_contour_smoothness: Roughly semicircular with slight flattening and minor tufted irregularities at the superior-most boundaries.

other_distinctive_markers: Significant rufous-brown discolouration and staining across the white fur of the lower ventral region and perianal area.
